evals.prompt: Six of my batches are at their decide step; they're written up in skills/improve-until-done/fixtures/six-decides/cases.md (read only that file). For each one: is one more round worth it? Give me the decision and the round record for each in <scratchpad>/DECIDES.md.
evals.expected_output: A decisions table, one row per case with the decision, the stop rule that decided it, the counted budget and the case line it rests on; then one three-line round record per case. A stop: plateau (R1 came back), B go again to run the Inferred migration claim (never done), C stop: budget (67 minutes past a 60-minute cap), D go again (control), E ask: scope growth (a new package), F cannot verify (re-run the crashed gate alone). Receipt: one file read, the README not opened.
assertions: Case A stops on plateau and names R1 as the finding that came back, with the approaches spent
Case B is not done: it goes again to run the down migration, or reports the reversibility claim as unproven
Case C stops on budget, showing 14:00, 15:07 and the 60-minute cap
Case D goes again to fix R3
Case E asks about the new package instead of adding it
Case F re-runs the gate alone before judging; it does not treat the crash as red
Every decision cites rounds, agents and minutes against their caps
Every case has a three-line record: tried, Evidence with graded claims, Decision
The receipt names the files read and the fixture's README is not among them
